title: Earning rewards for good grades
summary: This document explains the “Earning rewards for good grades” program: a $62.50 annual cash bonus for verifying a 3.0+ GPA, plus linked savings APY boosts of +0.85% (Bronze) or +0.45% (Platinum Plus) added to the standard APY for up to 12 months while good-standing is active. It details eligibility, required proof and verification via the Rho-Bank app/secure message center, timing, renewal/re-qualification, and what to do if submissions are declined (e.g., name mismatch, missing grading scale, GPA < 3.0).
faqs: How do I qualify for the $62.50 annual cash bonus and the GPA requirement?
What APY boost amounts do I get for linking a Bronze Savings Account vs a Platinum Plus Savings Account?
What documents are accepted to verify my 3.0+ GPA, and what details must they include?
How do I submit my GPA verification, and how long does it take for approval and rewards to be applied?
Do part-time, transfer, or graduate students qualify, and how should transfers with a reset GPA be handled?
What happens if my GPA submission is declined, and how can I fix the common issues?
